name: extynt
description: An LLM-agnostic runtime for controlling creative applications through MCP, plugins, and sidecars.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @extynt/action-plan build && pnpm --filter @extynt/llm build && node scripts/run-tests.ts --all
scripts.test:root: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @extynt/action-plan build && pnpm --filter @extynt/llm build && node scripts/run-tests.ts --root
scripts.test:live: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @extynt/action-plan build && pnpm --filter @extynt/llm build && node scripts/run-tests.ts --live
